ddl.name: inbox_events_fields_check
ddl.value: ("kind" = 'OwnerMessage' AND "channel" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_update_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "text" IS NOT NULL AND "sent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "schedule_id" IS NULL AND "due_at" IS NULL AND "press_id" IS NULL AND "pending_approval_id" IS NULL AND "answer" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'ScheduleFired' AND "schedule_id" IS NOT NULL AND "due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "channel" IS NULL AND "channel_update_id" IS NULL AND "conversation_id" IS NULL AND "channel_message_id" IS NULL AND "text" IS NULL AND "forward_origin" IS NULL AND "sent_at" IS NULL AND "press_id" IS NULL AND "pending_approval_id" IS NULL AND "answer" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'ApprovalAnswered' AND "channel" IS NOT NULL AND "press_id" IS NOT NULL AND "conversation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pending_approval_id" IS NOT NULL AND "answer" IS NOT NULL AND "channel_update_id" IS NULL AND "text" IS NULL AND "forward_origin" IS NULL AND "sent_at" IS NULL AND "schedule_id" IS NULL AND "due_at" IS NULL)

ddl.name: notes_open_loop_check
ddl.value: ("open_loop_kind" IS NULL AND "open_loop_state" IS NULL AND "open_loop_closed_reason" IS NULL AND "open_loop_due_at" IS NULL) OR ("open_loop_kind" IS NOT NULL AND trim("open_loop_kind") <> '' AND "open_loop_state" IS 'open' AND "open_loop_closed_reason" IS NULL) OR ("open_loop_kind" IS NOT NULL AND trim("open_loop_kind") <> '' AND "open_loop_state" IS 'closed' AND "open_loop_closed_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "open_loop_closed_reason" IN ('done', 'dropped', 'replaced'))

ddl.name: proactive_messages_outcome_sent_check
ddl.value: "outcome" IS NULL OR ("sent_message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "window_ends_at" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: pending_approvals_draft_check
ddl.value: "state" <> 'draft' OR ("channel_message_id" IS NULL AND "result" IS NULL)
